name: SSY Group Limited
summary: SSY Group Limited, an investment holding company, researches, develops, manufactures, trades, and sells various pharmaceutical products to hospitals and distributors in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers intravenous infusion solutions, including non-PVC and upright soft bag, PP plastic bottle, and glass bottle infusion solutions, as well as ampoule injections. It also provides small volume injections, oral preparations, chinese medicine preparations, and biological preparations, as well as bulk pharmaceutical products and medical materials.
